sourcePlan: d7e9b5e4023c60de0e5fb570d3a20b09.png; north seminar, three west studios, open central platform (user correction), east laboratory, south Koala
scopeNotes: 用户于 2026-10-28 明确：二楼中央是开放大平台，无围合房间和门。平台与环廊连续连通；实景设施待核实。
机电实验区新增独立传动装配台、工具车、零件架和座椅，形成可交互工作岛。齿轮、皮带与送料实验是游戏设计提案，设备摆位并非现场测绘。
按用户最新更正：蓝色构架和彩色圆凳属于二楼大厅，已从四楼移除。复用二楼开放大平台，保留中央横向通道，不增加房间围墙或门；精确现场摆位仍需对齐。
所有储物柜、零件架及茶水柜统一按柜背落地点贴墙，避开窗洞、门口与其他家具，保留柜前通行。新增数量为评审布局，非现场清点结果。

photoDetailReference.scope: Photo-derived furniture types and materials. Existing architectural layout and colliders retained; exact furniture counts and room assignment are review proposals, not surveyed facts.

roboticsReference.scope: Furniture grouping remains a playable review proposal. East frontage is corrected separately from the original plan and photo materials; other rooms are unchanged.

roboticsFrontage.evidence: Plan determines operable east frontage; photos guide gray metal frames, glazing and safety dots. Exact panel count and opening angle are presentation choices, not surveyed dimensions.
roboticsFrontage.scope: Only the ASABE east frontage and its threshold/outer contour; room size, furniture, other rooms and progression are retained.

objectScope: Independent furniture and mounted equipment. Four 3F studios use the user-requested facing-row duplication; the pantry uses six masters derived from user-supplied site photography. Laboratory objects follow the supplied equipment requirements. 2F platform activity islands are gameplay staging proposals. Exact site placement, room capacity, unique team vehicles and specialist machines remain under review.
